text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multiple organized paragraphs on separate goals","quality":"text organization","description":"The essay is organized into distinct sections that each develop a different idea, making the writing easier to follow."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like \"First thing I will like to accomplish\" and \"Last thing I have to say\"","quality":"coherent structure","description":"It uses clear framing language to move through ideas in a more deliberate sequence."},{"evidence":"extended explanations in each paragraph","quality":"development","description":"The essay elaborates on its points with more supporting detail rather than mostly repeating the same idea."},{"evidence":"\"My dad always said\" and \"Fact checkers say\"","quality":"varied sentence openings","description":"It shows more variety in how sentences begin, which makes the writing feel less repetitive."},{"evidence":"\"I have stared to play basketball more\" \"It does not hurt to learn\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"Although there are errors, the essay generally maintains more controllable sentence-level expression than the other essay."},{"evidence":"\"Ludwig Witgettein\" \"corona virus\"","quality":"specific references","description":"It incorporates concrete references and examples that give the writing more developed content and specificity."}]}
